03 / THE POSSIBILITIES

Ideas beyond the footage.

AI-assisted stories built with careful prompts, consistent visuals, and a human editorial eye.

Behind the edit

An idea is just
the beginning.

Good work comes from understanding the story, exploring the possibilities, and refining the details.

  1. 01

    Find the story

    Understand the audience, the message, and what the piece needs to say.

  2. 02

    Build the visual direction

    Plan the sequence, gather footage, or develop storyboards and AI visuals.

  3. 03

    Give it rhythm

    Bring the edit together with pacing, captions, motion, and sound.

  4. 04

    Refine. Then deliver.

    Work through feedback, polish the details, and prepare the final format.

A little about me

Hi, I’m Mark.
I connect the frames.

I’m Mark Joshua Briones, a video editor and AI content creator with a love for visual storytelling. I work across creator videos, short-form social content, and AI-assisted production.

My approach brings together thoughtful pacing, supporting visuals, and sound. Whether I’m shaping existing footage or developing a story from an idea, I care about how every piece fits.
